# Rain or Shine Apps

> Rain or Shine Apps is a small independent app developer based in the UK. Our main product is Brickify, an app for iPhone and Android that turns a smartphone into a brick phone on a schedule you set.

## Brickify

Brickify is for parents setting up a child's first phone, families with a smartphone-free school policy, and adults who want a digital detox on their own phone. You build profiles (for example Brick: calls and texts only; Brick plus: maps, music and bus times; Friends: one messaging app at set times) and a weekly schedule. The phone switches between profiles by itself. Opening a more open profile early needs a PIN plus a second factor, with recovery codes.

- Price: free to download and set up; a one-time in-app purchase of $4.99 / £4.99 switches blocking on for good. No subscription. One purchase covers every phone that uses the same App Store or Google Play account.
- Platforms: iPhone 8 / X or newer (iOS 16+), Android 8+.
- Brickify is not a monitoring app. It doesn't read messages, browsing history or location.
- It works on a phone you already own, including an old phone in a drawer, so no second device is needed.
